description: This file contains utility functions for URL and route handling in Next.js, including parameter sanitization, route matching, URL compilation, and destination preparation.

methods.name: getSafeParamName
methods.description: Sanitizes parameter names to contain only alphabetic characters for safe URL interpolation.

methods.name: matchHas
methods.description: Checks if a request matches specified route conditions based on headers, cookies, query, and host.

methods.name: compileNonPath
methods.description: Replaces route parameters in a string with their corresponding values, escaping special characters.

methods.name: prepareDestination
methods.description: Prepares and constructs a URL destination with parameters and query merging, handling relative and absolute URLs.
